uri.description: The message being reacted to, as a record URI in the same space. Readers prefer it over `target` when it is valid.

emoji.description: The reaction, as an emoji or a custom shortcode.

bridged.description: Who reacted on another service. Honoured only when the community itself wrote the record.

customEmoji.description: The emoji record behind a custom shortcode, so viewers who don't have the emoji can still show it.

main.description: A reaction to a message in the same channel space.
